description: The read-only REST surface itself plus CORS, built on the FEAT-001 accessors. Adds four new JAX-RS GET resources (paths, spectrum, topology, stats), a CORS ContainerResponseFilter, registers all of them in RsaWebApplication.getClasses(), and updates BUILD deps only if a new dep is actually required. Reuses the existing encodeResult JSON style. Purely additive: the existing RsaPathWebResource (POST/GET/DELETE /onos/rsa/path and /path/{id}) is left exactly as-is. Depends on FEAT-001 because the resources call listActive()/slotCount()/spectrumSnapshot()/blockedCount().
steps: Factor the shared RsaResult-to-JSON serialization so the new /paths endpoint matches single-result encoding. Either (a) make RsaPathWebResource.encodeResult visible to the new resource by moving it to a small package-private static helper class org.onosproject.rsa.web.RsaJson with `static ObjectNode encodeResult(ObjectMapper mapper, RsaResult r)`, and have RsaPathWebResource delegate to it (behavior identical), or (b) duplicate the exact field set. Prefer (a) to avoid drift. The encoded object MUST keep the current fields and order: requestId, blocked(false), src, dst, startSlot, width, devices[] (first link src deviceId then each link dst deviceId), links[] ({src,dst} as ConnectPoint strings), ochSignal (OchSignalCodec.encode). Do not change RsaPathWebResource's HTTP behavior.

Create apps/rsa/src/main/java/org/onosproject/rsa/web/RsaPathsWebResource.java: @Path("paths"), a single @GET @Produces(APPLICATION_JSON) method returning an object {"paths": [ <encodeResult for each listActive()> ]} (array of the same shape as a single path result). Use get(RsaService.class).listActive(). Extend AbstractWebResource; use mapper()/ok().

Create apps/rsa/src/main/java/org/onosproject/rsa/web/RsaSpectrumWebResource.java: @Path("spectrum"), @GET returning {"slotCount": N, "links": [ {"src": cpStr, "dst": cpStr, "occupiedSlots": [..], "freeSlotCount": k, "maxContiguousFree": m, "reservations": [ {"requestId":..,"startSlot":..,"width":..} ]} ]}. Source the data from get(RsaService.class).spectrumSnapshot() and slotCount(). ConnectPoint rendered via toString() for readable src/dst (keys are undirected per SpectrumTable).

Create apps/rsa/src/main/java/org/onosproject/rsa/web/RsaTopologyWebResource.java: @Path("topology"), @GET returning {"nodes": [ {"id": deviceIdStr, "name": annotations value of AnnotationKeys.NAME (fallback to id when absent), "type": device.type().toString()} ], "links": [ {"src": cpStr, "dst": cpStr, "capacity": slotCount, "used": occupiedCountOnThatUndirectedLink, "utilization": used/capacity as double} ]}. Get devices from get(org.onosproject.net.device.DeviceService.class).getDevices(); get links from get(org.onosproject.net.link.LinkService.class).getActiveLinks(); overlay per-link used/utilization by matching each link's undirected endpoints against the FEAT-001 spectrum snapshot's LinkSpectrum (used = slotCount - freeSlotCount; 0 when the link has no occupancy entry). To keep node list meaningful you may restrict nodes to ROADM/optical devices if desired, but including all devices is acceptable; document whichever you choose. Both DeviceService and LinkService are standard CORE_DEPS services already available to this app.

Create apps/rsa/src/main/java/org/onosproject/rsa/web/RsaStatsWebResource.java: @Path("stats"), @GET returning {"totalLinks": L, "totalSlots": L*slotCount, "usedSlots": sum of used across links, "overallUtilization": usedSlots/totalSlots (0.0 when totalSlots==0), "activeRequests": listActive().size(), "blockedCount": blockedCount(), "maxContiguousFree": max over links of maxContiguousFree, "averageFragmentation": average over links of (1 - maxContiguousFree/max(freeSlotCount,1)) for links with freeSlotCount>0, else 0.0}. Compute from spectrumSnapshot(). Clearly document each KPI's formula in javadoc.

Create apps/rsa/src/main/java/org/onosproject/rsa/web/RsaCorsFilter.java implementing javax.ws.rs.container.ContainerResponseFilter and annotated @javax.ws.rs.ext.Provider. In filter(ContainerRequestContext req, ContainerResponseContext resp) add response headers: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * , Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS , Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type, Authorization . Follow the registration pattern of web/api/.../AuditFilter.java (a ContainerResponseFilter registered via getClasses). For OPTIONS preflight, add an @Path-less lightweight handler is NOT needed if the JAX-RS runtime already answers OPTIONS; to be safe add a @Path("{any:.*}") @OPTIONS method ONLY inside each new resource is overkill — instead rely on the response filter to stamp CORS headers on the container's default OPTIONS response. If testing shows OPTIONS returns 405, add a small catch-all OPTIONS resource class org.onosproject.rsa.web.RsaCorsPreflightResource with @Path("{path:.*}") @OPTIONS returning Response.ok() so the filter can decorate it. Keep the Allow-Origin value configurable-by-constant and documented; scope is the RSA app only because it is registered solely in RsaWebApplication.

Update apps/rsa/src/main/java/org/onosproject/rsa/web/RsaWebApplication.java getClasses() to register all new classes alongside the existing one: getClasses(RsaPathWebResource.class, RsaPathsWebResource.class, RsaSpectrumWebResource.class, RsaTopologyWebResource.class, RsaStatsWebResource.class, RsaCorsFilter.class [, RsaCorsPreflightResource.class if created]).

Review apps/rsa/BUILD: COMPILE_DEPS = CORE_DEPS + JACKSON + REST + optical-model. DeviceService, LinkService, ConnectPoint, Device, AnnotationKeys, JAX-RS container filter interfaces, and OchSignalCodec are all already on this classpath (CORE_DEPS + REST + optical-model). Only add a dep if a compile error proves one is missing; if so, add the minimal target and record which one in findings. Most likely NO BUILD change is needed.
acceptance_criteria: Four new resource classes exist and are registered in RsaWebApplication; the existing RsaPathWebResource is unchanged in HTTP behavior (POST/GET/DELETE /onos/rsa/path[/{id}]).
RsaCorsFilter is registered only in RsaWebApplication (does not affect other ONOS REST contexts).
JSON field names are camelCase and /paths entries match the single-result encodeResult shape.
verification: Confirm the oar artifact exists: ls -l /home/manager/build/onos-2.7.0/bazel-bin/apps/rsa/onos-apps-rsa-oar.oar
findings:
Implemented the read-only REST surface + CORS, purely additive on top of FEAT-001 accessors.

New files (apps/rsa/src/main/java/org/onosproject/rsa/web/):
- RsaJson.java: package-private shared encoder `static ObjectNode encodeResult(ObjectMapper, RsaResult)`. Used option (a): moved the exact field set/order out of RsaPathWebResource (requestId, blocked=false, src, dst, startSlot, width, devices[], links[]{src,dst}, ochSignal via OchSignalCodec.encode). RsaPathWebResource.encodeResult now delegates to RsaJson.encodeResult(mapper(), result); its HTTP behavior (POST/GET/DELETE /path[/{id}]) is unchanged.
- RsaPathsWebResource.java: @Path("paths") GET -> {"paths":[<encodeResult per listActive()>]}.
- RsaSpectrumWebResource.java: @Path("spectrum") GET -> {slotCount, links:[{src,dst,occupiedSlots[],freeSlotCount,maxContiguousFree,reservations:[{requestId,startSlot,width}]}]} from spectrumSnapshot()/slotCount(); endpoints via ConnectPoint.toString().
- RsaTopologyWebResource.java: @Path("topology") GET -> {nodes:[{id,name(AnnotationKeys.NAME fallback id),type}], links:[{src,dst,capacity=slotCount,used=slotCount-freeSlotCount(0 when no entry),utilization=used/capacity}]}. Nodes = ALL devices from DeviceService.getDevices() (not restricted to ROADM; documented in javadoc). Links = LinkService.getActiveLinks(); per-link used overlaid by matching an undirected endpoint key (normalized ConnectPoint pair) against the snapshot LinkSpectrum.
- RsaStatsWebResource.java: @Path("stats") GET -> {totalLinks, totalSlots=totalLinks*slotCount, usedSlots, overallUtilization(0.0 when totalSlots==0), activeRequests, blockedCount, maxContiguousFree(max over links), averageFragmentation(avg over links with freeSlotCount>0 of 1-maxContiguousFree/freeSlotCount, else 0.0)}. totalLinks counts snapshot links (links with occupancy entries) — documented in javadoc.
- RsaCorsFilter.java: @Provider ContainerResponseFilter stamping Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* , Allow-Methods: GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS , Allow-Headers: Content-Type, Authorization. Origin kept as a documented constant (ALLOW_ORIGIN). Registered ONLY in RsaWebApplication so scope is /onos/rsa only. Followed the AuditFilter/CoreWebApplication ContainerResponseFilter pattern.

Modified:
- RsaPathWebResource.java: delegates encoding to RsaJson; removed now-unused imports (ArrayNode, Link, OchSignalCodec). No behavior change.
- RsaWebApplication.java: getClasses() now registers RsaPathWebResource, RsaPathsWebResource, RsaSpectrumWebResource, RsaTopologyWebResource, RsaStatsWebResource, RsaCorsFilter.

RsaCorsPreflightResource was NOT created: per the step, rely on the response filter to stamp CORS headers on the container's default OPTIONS response. If live testing shows OPTIONS -> 405, add org.onosproject.rsa.web.RsaCorsPreflightResource (@Path("{path:.*}") @OPTIONS returning Response.ok()) and register it. Not verified live in this step (build-only).

BUILD: NO change needed. All services/types (DeviceService, LinkService, ConnectPoint, Device, AnnotationKeys, JAX-RS container filter interfaces, OchSignalCodec) resolved on the existing CORE_DEPS + JACKSON + REST + optical-model classpath; the build compiled cleanly.

Artifact present at bazel-bin/apps/rsa/onos-apps-rsa-oar.oar (37267 bytes); confirmed all six new .class files are inside the oar's WEB-INF/classes. Live hotswap/curl verification into the onos-mno-27 pod was NOT performed in this step (FEAT verification is build-only) and remains available per context.json for a later live-verify step.
